## Constitutional compliance *(standing category — always include)*

Unlike the sample categories above, these items are not placeholders. Every generated checklist keeps
this category, renumbered to follow the items before it.

- [ ] Is the source of every exam weight and item count stated rather than assumed? (Principle I)
- [ ] Is the single-source rule for study content written so a build step can enforce it?
      (Principle II)
- [ ] Are the no-account, no-install, no-API-key, and no-analytics constraints expressed as testable
      requirements rather than aspirations? (Principle III)
- [ ] Is weight-proportional coverage quantified concretely enough to review a design against?
      (Principle IV)
- [ ] Are originality, attribution, and dated-source obligations covered? (Principle V)
- [ ] Are the accessibility and performance requirements quantified? (Principle VIII)
